display.purpose: Hero headline, section titles, entry titles, eyebrows/labels.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrows and masthead nav.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered fade/rise on section content (0.7s), respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled CTA, one per major section (email).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #14171a; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f8f63; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Marked Link
components.description: Underlined text link; underline shifts to the accent on hover. Used for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-link-marked { color: #14171a; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #dde1d9; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-link-marked:hover { text-decoration-color: #0f8f63; }

components.name: Timeline Node
components.description: Accent-ringed circle marking one Experience entry on the vertical hairline rail.
components.css: .ds-timeline-node { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #0f8f63; background: #f5f6f3; }

components.name: Marked Headline Phrase
components.description: Thin accent underline band behind a key phrase in a headline — the system's one 'highlighter' moment per viewport.
components.css: .ds-mark { background-image: linear-gradient(#0f8f63, #0f8f63); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 0 96%; background-size: 100% 0.16em; }

narrative.overview: The site reads like a technical working paper, not a finished résumé or a dashboard: strong typographic hierarchy carries the authority, generous margins give the content room to breathe, and one confident accent color is spent the way a reader marks a key claim — never as a status light, never as page-filling chrome. A faint growth-curve figure runs through the page as watermark and, in Experience, as the literal spine of the timeline.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial masthead + single reading column, not a persistent dashboard sidebar
One accent color (signal green), spent only on marks, links, and timeline nodes
Display sans for headline authority, text-optimized serif for long-form reading
A single growth-curve SVG figure reused as hero watermark and Experience spine

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: The accent color never fills a region larger than a timeline node or an underline stroke.

rules.name: The No-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Labels and eyebrows are set in the display sans, not a monospace face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface sits at the same visual depth; nothing is elevated with a shadow.

dos: Do spend the accent color only on the mark stroke, link-hover underlines, and timeline nodes.
Do keep every section inside the single max-w-3xl reading column.
Do set eyebrows and labels in Schibsted Grotesk, never mono.
donts: Don't reintroduce a persistent sidebar/dashboard nav.
Don't add a second saturated accent color or a status-light pairing.
Don't add shadows, card elevation, or pill/chip-styled tags.
Don't let the growth-curve watermark exceed ~35% opacity or grow more visually complex.
